title: Trading APP - Collab, Learn, Build together
author: AiThat
selftext:
​

Starting a small group chat for people actually building their own trading systems(rule based, AI assisted etc.,)  not selling anything, not another Discord funnel.

If you're writing backtests, building screeners, wiring up an AI coding agent to help you code strategies, or testing entry/exit ideas for your own personal use, this is for people like you. Doesn't matter if you're a professional trader, a programmer with zero markets background, or neither, and just learning as you go. What matters is you've actually built something, even something rough, and you want to compare notes, get honest pushback, and get better.

Rules are simple. No selling, no promoting a paid product or service, no course pitches. No putting anyone down for their skill level or their results, good or bad. Participation is expected, this isn't a place to lurk and watch, everyone shares what they're working on. And if you're just here to be negative or tell everyone the market can't be beaten, this isn't the right group, plenty of other places for that conversation.

Drop a comment or DM me if you want in. Tell me one thing you're building or have built.
